title: GTBH Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 17 Consultant Posts
description: The Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 17 Stenographer, Junior Assistant, and Senior Assistant Jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their 12th or any degree can apply for the GTBH Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can attend the walk-in at the given venue.
